rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when an action or event causes a reaction, result, or disturbance.

example.english: This news can generate a lot of discussion.
example.traditional: 呢單新聞可以引起好多討論。
example.jyutping: nei1 daan1 san1 man4 ho2 ji5 jan5 hei2 hou2 do1 tou2 leon6

rows.note: Use this for bringing something into existence, especially an abstract result or heat and energy; it is more about producing a result than causing an event.

example.english: This chemical reaction will generate heat.
example.traditional: 呢個化學反應會產生熱力。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 faa3 hok6 faan2 jing3 wui5 caan2 saang1 jit6 lik6
